characterization_status: Characterized single GET operation with 57 pristine source fixtures and eleven corrected-source overrides, stored in the shared public_feedback fixture directories. Go reuses the established issue query, filtering, pagination, and grouping components. Grouped module membership is based on live issue-module bridges before pagination; ungrouped issue annotations retain the source raw module relation projection. Pending intake rows visible in grouped results contribute to the same filtered-queryset totals as their buckets.

split_reason: This independent GET route was separated from the 12-operation public_feedback family because it uses the same shared public route and issue query components but needed its own live-bridge grouping and filtered-row count characterization. It is now implemented and its Django route is retired atomically with the Go owner.

differential_replay.effects: The operation is read-only; the production-proxy differential compares HTTP status, headers and body.

scope_decisions: The contract contains only the public issue collection GET and its HEAD/OPTIONS protocol companions.
Collection filtering and pagination reuse the shared issue query implementation; search remains source-recorded as ignored.
Grouped module membership uses live issue-module bridges before pagination. Missing relationships remain in the None bucket, while deleted-only relationships are excluded.
Ungrouped module annotations preserve the raw collection projection. Subgroup-only module selection remains flat pagination with the scalar relationship projection and no module_ids field.
Grouped result and subgroup totals count each row in the filtered queryset, including pending intake rows returned in those groups.
